description:
Direct Download:

https://github.com/meatball-the-starsector-kind/Torchships-Meatball-fork/releases/download/v0.18/Torchships-Meatball-fork.zip

Kudos to Tartiflette for the original mod.

Always DELETE the old version before extracting the new one

Requires LazyLib and MagicLib

NOT save compatible if you’re running an older version of Torchships

A small-ish collection of ships wings and weapons focusing on seamless integration next to the vanilla game. This isn't the flashiest or the deadliest of the content mods around, but it should hopefully provide some interesting variations and combinations to the vanilla factions fleets.

Updated for 0.98, with some graphical/mechanical improvements to existing Pirate/Pather variants.

Changelogs

0.18

BALANCING:

Updated existing Pirate and Pather ships mechanically/graphically for 0.98 standards.

Ships

- Challenger (P)-class frigate - Added Unstable Injector, slightly altered engines
- Challenger (LP)-class frigate - Slightly altered engines.

- Pest (P)-class frigate - Added squiggly wiggly wires to its engines.
- Pest Cutter-class frigate - Made engines more “hot rod-y”.

- Bully (P)-class destroyer - Ripped out the missile mount, replaced it with Lidar Array.
- Bully (LP)-class destroyer - Ripped out missile mount, transplanted to frontal hardpoints.

- Foray (P)-class cruiser - RETURNED THE VENTURE BAY
- Foray (LP)-class cruiser - NYOOOOMMMMM

- High-tide (P)-class cruiser - Gave it another pair of small turrets to compensate for the missing bay.

- Bonnethead (P)-class cruiser - Returned mounts, added bays.
- Bonnethead (LP)-class cruiser - Returned mounts, added mounts.

- Niagara (P)-class battleship - Returned mounts, gutted mounts, added Lidar Array.
